def: properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside

occurrences.text: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
